title: Discipline Over Talent | A Discipline Short Film
lines: He wasn't the most talented in the room.
He was the one who stayed longest.
Talent starts the race. Discipline finishes it.
The gifted get bored. The disciplined get better.
You can't control your talent. You can control your effort.
So outwork everyone, including your own doubt.
Twenty days in, and he's already someone new.
